Name: Azure Backup Smart Tiering Policy Remediator
Description: Can read Recovery Services vaults and read/update backup policies for enable-only Smart Tiering automation. Note: backupPolicies/write is full policy-update authority - a policy write can change schedules and retention and therefore the lifetime of recovery points. The role grants no direct delete action; NotActions cannot restrict permissions granted elsewhere. Assign it at the narrowest scope that contains the target policies.
